x-groups.title: Connection
x-groups.description: The AWS account and region, and how to sign in.

x-groups.title: Streams
x-groups.description: Which Kinesis streams rows go to, and how missing ones are created.

x-groups.title: Records
x-groups.description: How each record's data is encoded.

x-groups.title: Retries
x-groups.description: Backoff and limits for throttled calls.

region.title: Region
region.description: The streams' AWS region. Unset: the AWS default configuration's.

accessKeyId.title: Access key ID
accessKeyId.description: An AWS access key, with secretAccessKey. Without one, the credentials of the role in aws.role, or the AWS default credentials.

endpoint.title: Endpoint
endpoint.description: A Kinesis-compatible endpoint: a VPC endpoint's, or an emulator's. Unset: the region's.

namespace.title: Namespace
namespace.description: Used when the pipeline names no namespace: streams are named namespace.table.

createStreams.title: Create missing streams
createStreams.description: Create a stream that doesn't exist, with the settings below. Off: a missing stream fails the write.

streamMode.title: Capacity mode

oneOf.title: On-demand
oneOf.description: Kinesis scales the stream's shards with its traffic.

streamMode.description: Created streams' capacity mode. An existing stream is left as it is.

shards.title: Shards
shards.description: Created streams' shards. It needs streamMode provisioned.

retentionHours.title: Retention
retentionHours.description: Created streams' retention period, in hours, from 24 to 8760. Over 24, a created stream keeps the tag openetl.io/setup until it has its retention and encryption, and if setting them fails, the next write sets them.

kmsKeyId.title: KMS key
kmsKeyId.description: Created streams are encrypted with this KMS key: its ID, ARN or alias. Unset: not encrypted. A created stream keeps the tag openetl.io/setup until it has its retention and encryption, and if setting them fails, the next write sets them.

partitionKey.title: Partition key
partitionKey.description: What each record's partition key is made of, which picks its shard.

mode.title: Partition by

oneOf.title: Primary key
oneOf.description: The row's primary key, or its _openetl_id without one: a key's rows go to one shard, in order.

oneOf.title: Columns
oneOf.description: The columns in fields: rows with the same values go to one shard, in order.

oneOf.title: Random
oneOf.description: A random key: rows spread evenly over shards, with no order between them.

mode.description: What partition keys are made of.

fields.title: Columns
fields.description: With mode fields: the columns whose values, as text, make the partition key.

ordering.title: Ordering

oneOf.title: Per partition key
oneOf.description: A request holds one record of each partition key, so retrying part of one can't put a key's records out of order.

oneOf.title: None
oneOf.description: Requests are filled freely: faster when a few keys have most rows, but retries can reorder a key's records.

ordering.description: Whether a key's records stay in order when Kinesis takes part of a request and the rest is sent again.

rateLimit.title: Rate limit
rateLimit.description: Caps on what one destination process sends, on average. Unset: none.

recordsPerSecond.title: Records a second
recordsPerSecond.description: The most records sent a second.

bytesPerSecond.title: Bytes a second
bytesPerSecond.description: The most bytes of data and partition keys sent a second.

format.title: Format

oneOf.title: JSON
oneOf.description: Each row as a JSON object.

format.description: How records' data is encoded. Avro and Protobuf register each stream's schema under <stream>-value.

schemaRegistryUrl.title: Schema registry URL
schemaRegistryUrl.description: A Confluent-compatible schema registry. Avro and Protobuf need one.

schemaRegistryUsername.title: Schema registry user
schemaRegistryUsername.description: A user for the schema registry's basic authentication, which sends the password as it is: use an https schemaRegistryUrl. Unset: none.

retry.title: Retries
retry.description: How calls that Kinesis throttles, or that fail for a moment, are retried.

initialBackoff.description: The first wait before a retry. Each wait is drawn at random up to this, doubled for each retry in a row, up to maxBackoff.
initialBackoff.title: Initial backoff

maxBackoff.description: The longest wait before a retry.
maxBackoff.title: Longest backoff

maxAttempts.title: Attempts per call
maxAttempts.description: How many times the AWS SDK tries one call, the first included, before it gives up on it.

maxElapsed.description: How long records may keep being throttled without a call getting through before the write fails with RATE_LIMITED. No wait between retries runs past it.
maxElapsed.title: Longest throttling
